verdict.rationale: Insomnia's core client is open-source (Apache-2.0) and can be run locally, and 'Git Sync' lets teams keep all project data in their own Git repo instead of Insomnia's cloud, effectively self-hosting the data layer without any cloud dependency. However, there's no documented self-hosted server/sync backend for teams (mocking, cloud sync are hosted by Insomnia Cloud), and community reports describe a 2023 change that suddenly required an account/login, prompting users to call it a 'rug pull' and seek fully offline-first alternatives. Missing for 10: an official self-hosted sync/collaboration server, explicit self-host deployment docs, and resolution of the account-requirement complaints.
